name: 4-in-1 Electric Lady Shaver for Women | Rechargeable Cordless Hair Remover | Bikini Trimmer, Nose & Eyebrow Trimmer | For Face, Legs & Underarms

Its cordless and rechargeable design makes it easy to use at home or while traveling, helping you maintain a neat and smooth appearance with ease.

Key Features

Designed for gentle and comfortable hair removal

Cordless design for convenient and flexible use

Lightweight and portable design

Select and attach the suitable grooming head
Ensure the device is charged before use
Gently stretch the skin in the desired area
Move the shaver slowly and gently along the direction of hair growth
Use the appropriate attachment for eyebrows or nose hair
Remove and clean the detachable head after use
Charge the device using the included USB cable when required

Material / Composition
Electronic Shaver Components
